province.costs: destination-local/stay costs only; never child POI costs

county.costs: county-owned costs only; never child POI costs

city.costs: city-owned costs only; never child POI costs

place.costs: costs occurring at this exact place

camping.costs: camping-site fees and onsite services only

globalRules.costs: Parent entities must never duplicate child costs. Aggregation is an application-level calculation.
globalRules.faq: Parent FAQ may reference children in prose only; operational child questions belong on the child Entity.
globalRules.checklist: Every Entity has an independent checklist. Only short concrete items; no prose, prices, routes, distances or child-specific facts.
globalRules.media: Each Entity has an independent photo set. Same image URL cannot be used by two Entities. Parent/child/sibling-only images are forbidden. Thumbnail counts toward target.
